confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Taiwanese price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by season, weekday and venue. Cocktail and wine are estimated from local restaurant and bar price levels rather than direct observation. The FX observation was taken from search results and was not opened on the RBA page itself; the 16 October 2026 value reported in search (0.6947) was not verified against an RBA page, so the 15 October figure is used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Taiwan's general price level, with Kaohsiung priced somewhat below Taipei for food, drink and accommodation. Benchmarked against other mid-sized Taiwanese cities and adjusted for Kaohsiung's lower costs.
